description: Parse a KiCad PCB layout (.kicad_pcb S-expression) to extract copper layer stackup names, board outline dimensions, SMD and through-hole pad counts, routed trace segment counts, circular arc counts, and via statistics. Call this tool first when inspecting an existing KiCad board before running DFM audits or submitting a cloud routing job. Accepts raw pcb_text (UTF-8 S-expression string) or a local project_path. Returns JSON with format, copper_layers, layer_count, total_pads, routed_segment_count, routed_arc_count, and via_count; if pcb_text is omitted or unreadable, falls back to the built-in 2l_rp2040 reference layout.

pcb_text.description: Raw UTF-8 KiCad .kicad_pcb S-expression file content (must begin with '(kicad_pcb'). Required for remote HTTP calls when project_path is unavailable. Example: '(kicad_pcb (version 20240108) ...)'.

project_path.description: Local filesystem path to a .kicad_pcb file on the client workstation (used in local STDIO mode; ignored over remote HTTP). Example: 'hardware/board.kicad_pcb'.

name: analyze_kicad_pcb
title: Analyze KiCad PCB Layout
